items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Marshall Royal was in the band, when we came there.

ctx.x: That was much later. And he didn't have Marshall.
Marshall Royal? He came in later also. We had two brothers in there. One played trombone and one played alto. And he did a lot of the arranging. Hey, Nell.

items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Marshal Royal, when something happened to him, he had to go to the hospital, and he got the other --

ctx.x: I remember, and was out for ages, wasn't he?
Yeah, and he didn't hire him back. Marshal Royal, when something happened to him, he had to go to the hospital, and he got the other --
In other words, don't get sick.
